column3: Close to the Hebrew; נְהָרוֹת (“the rivers”) is rendered “the waters.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to falsehood” is rendered “to an idol,” following the traditional reading “his soul.”
The Hebrew “who seek your face, O Jacob” is restructured as “This is Jacob… Who seek Your face.”
